name: manual_00e2a1
claim: A real live turn exists to test the pair in real-world conditions, so point it at real work with the real evaluator: real reviewer comments on an open pull request, real failing CI, and the repository's own tests plus cases taken from the reviewer's own stated inputs. Do not invent a corpus and an answer key and grade the model on them; that tests the author's assumptions, not the pair. Before designing any live experiment, look for real feedback that already exists (gh api pulls comments and reviews) and use it as the task and the spec.
conditions: live pair loop real world testing real reviewer comments evaluator

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: I built a synthetic held-out corpus for the first live pair loop; the operator pointed out live turns are for real-world testing. The run was stopped before its request completed. A check of the open pull requests then found four real CodeRabbit comments on the pair's own code, two of which exposed defects the local fixes had not covered.
